basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old college student from Amarillo, Texas, currently majoring in computer science. I've recently developed an interest in gaming, especially on my new PS4. Apart from gaming, I enjoy tinkering with tech gadgets and improving my living space's air quality, which explains my frequent visits to the AirPurifiers subreddit. I am single and usually online during late-night hours after finishing my assignments and part-time job at a local tech store.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a computer science student, I have a decent understanding of technology and software. Most of my knowledge comes from coursework and personal projects, like building small apps or troubleshooting tech issues. However, I'm still learning about gaming systems and rely heavily on online communities and threads to gather information.
